records.name: lpac-stream-sequential-boundary-amendment-01.json
records.representation: source preparation snapshot; historical false/pending fields remain historical

baseline.preservation: All prior source/ABIs/artifacts/actual evidence stay immutable. The prior successful RPB1 mapping is not relabeled byte streaming. Parallel lpac_pipe_dns names and contract are disjoint.

challenge_and_actual_bytes.construction: Root generates two different fresh binary files, each containing every byte value including NUL and framing-looking bytes plus independent unpredictable bytes. Raw payloads are not deterministically generated from run/case/opcode, and no payload seed is supplied to actors.
challenge_and_actual_bytes.fragmentation: Use different predeclared caps at client frame creation, pipe write/read and ordinary socket send/receive, with non-aligned1/31/257/1024-like splits and a body spanning multiple windows. These are API I/O fragment limits, not claims about TCP packet segmentation. Exact bytes must survive partial I/O and coalescing.
challenge_and_actual_bytes.independent_physical_evidence: After held exits, the reader hashes original request/response inputs and actual origin-request, relay-transmit, relay-receive and selected-response raw sink files. Every source-provided byte count must match its physical sink length. Request hashes must agree across input/relay/origin and response hashes across input/origin-send evidence/relay/selected. Hashes are computed by the file-only reader; native hashing/CNG resources need not be added merely for reporting.
challenge_and_actual_bytes.ordinary_input: The independent response.bin remains in an ordinary-only current-user/SYSTEM input directory; it is not copied into selected readable inputs. Source-bound origin reads that file only after the actual request/EOF. No actor may fabricate received data from an expected response fixture.
challenge_and_actual_bytes.selected_input: One exact fresh request.bin is read-only in the selected-owned input scope. The selected client reads these bytes, writes them through DATA frames and writes received response bytes to a fresh bounded private sink.

clock_and_cleanup.epoch: One actual QPC frequency/domain and original T0. RootD=T0+120F, workerD=rootD-5F; all setup is inside rootD. Work reserve remains rootD-35F. PairS is sampled before pair allocation/creation; PairE=PairS+10F, must fit the work reserve. Creation, observer, parent closes, resume, stream, child exits and native reports fit that same pair, never now+10 renewal.
clock_and_cleanup.runtime_shape: Default preflight is read-only. A separate explicit opt-in and source/device/two-artifact/challenge/recovery plan is required. No auto retry, capability fallback, namespace exemption, firewall/DNS/route/system-proxy mutation or OS reinstall.
clock_and_cleanup.scope_of_waits: Origin uses the predeclared work deadline, but its normal exit must be explicitly observed before PairE on a positive result. All actor report final ticks precede that actor's own held exit observation; completion follows all relevant final/exit observations and precedes PairE.
clock_and_cleanup.stop_order: Stop/confirm all held workloads and exact Jobs empty; close known pipes/process/thread/token/file/socket resources once; restore owned output labels; remove exact SID ACEs with readback; delete only owned profile; release SID. Unknown allocation/observer/creation/close/cleanup blocks profile deletion and retains recovery_required/private tree.

identity_and_ownership.construction: Reuse only the qualified ownership semantics: CREATE_SUSPENDED, selected SECURITY_CAPABILITIES0+AAP1+atomicJOB_LIST+exactHANDLE_LIST2; relay atomicJOB_LIST+exactHANDLE_LIST2. No broad inheritance/breakaway/extra capability. Durable raw return/PI receipt precedes interpretation/adoption; failed/partial CreatePipe/CreateProcess outputs remain indeterminate unless the exact known-no-child predicate is satisfied.
identity_and_ownership.files_and_labels: Source/device/plan/artifact/challenge pins and fresh private root; exact request-read/output-write scope only for selected. Ordinary response and evidence remain ordinary-only. Low-MIC changes apply only to fresh selected output subtree, with pre-state absence and post-stop absence readback. Never modify ancestors, broad user data, global policies or imported old scopes.
identity_and_ownership.ordinary_admission: Exact held ordinary user/session/primary/non-AC/cap0/image/generation and exact Jobs for relay/origin. Ordinary tools keep their existing separate supervised identity and lifetime.
identity_and_ownership.pipes: Two protected anonymous pipes; exactly four parent endpoints, two role-specific child endpoints each. Read back pipe type, SD and inheritance. Parent closes all four once before either pair child resumes; each child clears/readbacks inheritance before protocol I/O. No named-pipe acquisition or caller authentication is asserted.
identity_and_ownership.selected_admission: Fresh standalone profile, exact expected SID, user/session, lowIL4096, primary/unelevated/UIAccessfalse, exactcap[], original held image/generation and exact inner+outer Jobs. Independently capture primary TokenStatistics and require real AccessCheck [2,0,0,2] with all observer resources closed before resume. No class46 fallback or native self-report authority.
identity_and_ownership.synchronous_boundary: Bounded frame size and credits do not make synchronous ReadFile/WriteFile/close internally cancellable. Keep the external atomic guard Job and hard absolute owner deadline. Any blocking/unknown API return or close remains unknown; no retry of consumed handles or fictional cancellation.

proposed_wire.backpressure: Only read/accept new DATA within available window and bounded local queue capacity. Relay grants request credit after actual socket send acceptance, selected grants response credit after actual sink consumption. Socket send acceptance alone is not remote receipt; the independent origin sink supplies that evidence. Never bypass a full window, grow an unbounded queue or fall back to a socket/direct path.
proposed_wire.endianness: Little endian integers; IDs raw16-byte decoded lowerhex values
proposed_wire.frame_rules: Strict run/case/stream/kind/flags/reserved checks; monotonically increasing sequence without wrap. DATA length1..1024 with credit0. CREDIT has no payload and returns1..4096 bytes, never more than outstanding delivered bytes or enough to exceed the4096 window. Other kinds have zero payload/credit. Bound all frames, counters, pending buffers and total bytes; malformed/replayed/oversized/unknown frames fail closed.
proposed_wire.half_close: FIN means no more DATA in that direction; CREDIT for the opposite direction remains legal. Relay defers SD_SEND until all preceding request bytes have been sent. Origin requires real request EOF. Relay sends its FIN only after real origin response EOF; selected flushes final credits and closes its writer after response FIN. Relay observes pipe EOF after outstanding credit/data drains, then closes its writer; selected observes final pipe EOF. Both directions, sink writes and handle closes must complete for success.
proposed_wire.handshake: LPAC sends OPEN; relay sends OPEN_OK only after the one owned-origin connect completes. No DATA before this handshake. OPEN/OPEN_OK have no payload, destination or extra authority.
proposed_wire.name: RPS1 single-stream byte protocol; new interface1, separate from RPB1
proposed_wire.relationship_to_file_bridge: Reuse bounded OPEN/DATA/FIN/RESET, nonce/sequence validation and fixed-target/backpressure ideas from file_bridge.py. Do not copy its64-stream registry, shared writable rings, ordinary listener into LPAC, file-lock retries or per-operation renewed timeouts.
proposed_wire.reset_and_partial: RESET, EOF in a partial frame, DATA after directional FIN, invalid credit, incomplete physical sink or any unknown close prevents success. Preserve actual bytes/counts and typed stage/error. RESET never substitutes for a successful EOF handshake.

content.single_question: Can one independently admitted genuine zero-cap LPAC cooperative client exchange actual application-provided binary bytes over its two inherited anonymous pipe endpoints, through one ordinary fixed-target socket, with end-to-end payload/EOF/ownership evidence?

smallest_new_build_and_code_boundary.build_gate: Root alone performs one full actor compile after frozen source/review. Immutable source snapshots precede compiler reads; separate manifests bind interface/wire/source/PE hashes. Portable production-code fake tests do not run actors. Static PE audit distinguishes selected no-network imports from ordinary networking imports.
smallest_new_build_and_code_boundary.ordinary_artifact: windows_identity_lpac_stream_network_actor.exe / identity-lpac-stream-network-manifest.json; relay and single-origin roles, ordinary Winsock only. Do not mutate or relabel existing B actor/manifest.
smallest_new_build_and_code_boundary.reuse_limits: Shared pure codec plus existing immutable native identity helper, exact ownership/ordinary tools/label cleanup and file-only validators where their API shapes match. No global monkeypatching, fabricated old schema fields, old RPB1 reducer regeneration or weakening of legacy validators. Final exact native include/import/runtime source counts are computed from implementation, not assumed here.
smallest_new_build_and_code_boundary.selected_artifact: windows_identity_lpac_stream_front_actor.exe / identity-lpac-stream-front-manifest.json; GUI/staticCRT; no WS2_32/DNSAPI/WinHTTP import or dynamic SOCKET import. It is a new cooperative byte client, not the prior mapped frontend artifact.

source_anchors.purpose: 16KiB framing bounds and OPEN/DATA/FIN/RESET semantics; parser321/373, ordinary fixed target588, guest TCP listener840 is not reusable as LPAC ingress.
Concrete real-application/core ownership and existing platform launch branches; separate opt-in adapter branch is needed.
Current TCP proxy environment/Chromium/Firefox adapters; none consumes the new pipe transport.
Linux namespace/privateproc path is a distinct product boundary, not a result of this Windows stream cell.

subsequent_application_and_real_core_pla.A2_real_core_cell: Run the actual configured Mihomo core through this ordinary fixed-port route, using a predeclared HTTP absolute-form request to an owned origin and an independently checked dynamic body. Bind core PID/generation/image/config/port and response. If current core routing cannot support this controlled request, stop; do not silently alter live rules/config, contact arbitrary external sites or claim a fake origin is the real core.
subsequent_application_and_real_core_pla.A2_transport_library: After A-min passes, provide a small cooperative open-fixed-proxy-stream/write/read/half-close API backed by the same codec. The broker's connect target becomes one held, source-bound existing manager core/mixed_port lease. The client still receives no SOCKET or arbitrary broker-connect destination.
subsequent_application_and_real_core_pla.A3_application_integration: Choose one source-modifiable or officially transport-extensible application. Add an explicit cooperative-pipe adapter identifier in launcher.prepare_app and a separate reviewed manager.launch branch only for that supported binary/version; pass the exact inherited endpoints via its supported adapter contract. Unknown applications, Chrome/Firefox TCP adapters and normal Windows launch stay unchanged. A source-bound repository diagnostic client is a first integration target, not browser/arbitrary-app support.
subsequent_application_and_real_core_pla.product_gate: Only after that real app is exercised: app profile/start/stop/child lifecycle, sustained and concurrent connections/interactive tunnels as supported, proxy-core crash handling, hostile identity/object/IPC boundaries, DNS/service and broader negative matrices plus independent qualification. One stream through a fixed port is not an all-API enforcement mechanism.

testing_and_acceptance_gates: Production portable codec: every header field/reserved byte, bytewise/coalesced/partial payload parsing,1/1024/1025 boundaries, sequence/replay/wrongrun/case, credit underflow/overflow/free-credit, DATA-after-FIN/duplicateFIN, partial EOF, frame/byte bounds and stale clock reject. No mirrors of implementation-only happy paths.

API-shaped inert coordination: exact two HANDLE_LIST values, lifetime of all attribute buffers, raw Create/PI/pipe receipts, alias/unknown once handling, real4-byte emptycap extent, external primary/matrix before resume, every parent close attempted, original QPC and cleanup fault paths.

Actual single positive: end-to-end independent binary challenge files and physical sinks match; no request/response opcode synthesis; fragmented API calls, bounded in-flight counters, handshake/CREDIT/FIN/EOF, socket/pipe/file cleanup, native tuple relation and all three held normal exits are independently bound. Timeout or missing bytes stays inconclusive.

Safe evidence: hashes/lengths, bounded frame/data/credit counts, status/error, original causal comparisons and cleanup flags. Raw payload, SID/PID/handles/private paths/ports/QPC and full native records stay private. No independent kernel live TCP snapshot is claimed unless separately implemented and tested.

topology.relay: Held ordinary zero-cap primary, source-bound separate executable; one predeclared owned numeric-loopback origin only. The relay copies actual DATA bytes and never generates an HTTP request/response from run/case/opcode.
topology.selected: Fresh zero-cap LPAC primary, source-bound IPC-only executable, exactly the two declared inherited pipe endpoints; no SOCKET, WSAPROTOCOL_INFO, process/token/Job handle or DNS API is supplied.
topology.target_authority: Target IP127.0.0.1 and owned port derive only from held origin READY plus immutable owner argv/config. No target, URL, DNS name, credential, redirect or arbitrary connect command exists in the pipe protocol.
